title: Railway RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 – Out
intro: Short Information : Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released the Railway RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 on their official websites. The recruitment was conducted for 22,195 Level 1 Group D posts. The online application process for Railway RRB Group D Recruitment 2026 was completed from 31 January 2026 to 09 March 2026. The CBT-I examination was conducted from 03 August to 21 August 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination will be able to check and download their Railway RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 once it is released. The answer key will help candidates review their responses and estimate their probable scores before the declaration of the result. The direct link to download the RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 will be provided below after its official release.
importantDates:
RRB Group D (Level 1) Recruitment 2026 : Document Required



Photo & Signature


The candidate’s photograph must be a recent passport-sized photograph and must be clear or white. The face must be clearly visible and the candidate must not be wearing a hat, glasses, or mask.
The signature should be made in black on white paper and should be clear and easily readable.




Aadhaar Card


Aadhaar number is required while filling the form, and it is mandatory to produce the original Aadhaar card during PET and document verification.




10th Class Marksheet


This document is used as a certificate of date of birth and educational qualification.




Caste / Category Certificates (If Applicable)


Candidates must have a valid SC/ST certificate, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate, or EWS certificate for the current financial year. The certificate must be issued in the format prescribed by the government.




PwBD / Disability Certificate (If Applicable)


The person with disability must have a disability certificate issued by a special medical board clearly stating the percentage of disability.




Ex-Serviceman Certificate (If Applicable)


Candidates must possess a valid Discharge Book or Service Certificate, in which the length of service is clearly mentioned.




Bank Account Details


Candidates must provide the account holder’s name, account number, and IFSC code, which are required for fee refund or future payments.




Domicile / Address Proof (If Asked)


Candidates may need to provide a state domicile certificate along with their permanent and correspondence address details, if required.




Other Useful Documents


Candidates must keep an active email ID and mobile number, along with the application/confirmation page printout and fee payment receipt, for future reference.




Note : Candidates must Keep all documents scanned and ready before form filling. Fill name, DOB, and parents’ names exactly as per 10th marksheet. Incorrect or fake documents can cancel selection. Carry originals with self-attested photocopies for verification. : Photo & Signature
